description:
While explorering the witch mountains of Escazú with Javier & Luis, they asked me about my views of the Bible & humanity. These are my candid thoughts, unscripted and unedited, on how humanity got where it is now & where we are headed. 

Let me know if end of this video hit you as hard as it hit me. Humanity was out here for a reason & we need to get back to it. God loves you & so do I. 
-Joe
